name: ATST Playground
description: Verifies ENS social media account attestations and returns the full step-by-step verification trace.

skills.name: Verify an ENS attestation
skills.description: Resolves the name's owner, reads the handle and envelope text records, reconstructs the signed DAG-CBOR payload, recovers the signer, and compares it to the attester's resolved address. Returns a step-by-step trace rather than a bare verdict.

request.name: ENS name to verify, for example 'nick.eth'.
request.attester: ENS name of the attester whose signature is expected.
request.uid: Required when mode is 'uid'; the spec leaves how a verifier obtains it out of scope.

response.reason: Failure reason: missing, bad-signature, unsupported-version, decode-error, attester-not-resolved, owner-not-resolved, rpc-error, or invalid-name.
response.steps: One entry per verification step, each with its status and the intermediate values it produced.
response.handoff: Everything needed to replay the attestation locally, present once the envelope decoded.
